experiments.consistency: Distinct >=50% and >=80% observed days/weeks, completed-week coverage, last completion age; sustained completion separates repeats from bursts/one-offs.
experiments.loyalty: Raw and watch-duration channel loyalty, channel completion/intensity and >=80% conditional programme popularity; differs from existing sqrt/soft-count channel score.
experiments.opportunity: Personally completed-event yield per historical broadcast and reliability-gated expected future completions/timing; future air count alone never boosts unseen items.

output_policy: unchanged V3 equal V2/GB reciprocal-rank fusion within unchanged pool; common cold fallback
selection: Main gain >=0.002, earlier >=0.001, paired lower95>0 both; light-history subgroup gain >=-0.003 both; no reversal under frequency-tie sensitivity. Otherwise retain V3.
